Call for expression of interest - International consultants Disability and Inclusion ACCESSIBILITY -
August 2021

Wishing to develop more and more efficiently its technical support activities (in an HI project or
under a consultancy) to other actors, HI launches this call for expression of interest for international
consultants in the field of disability and inclusion. This call for expressions of interest concerns in
particular specialists in ACCESSIBILITY, including the field of digital accessibility and communication.

I. Objectives and targeted missions

1. Objectives of the call for applications

General objective
The general objective of this call for applications is to enable HI to strengthen its technical expertise
in the field of inclusion and disability, in all its fields, contexts and sectors of intervention, in addition
to the technical expertise of HI's permanent teams.

The specific objectives
 Facilitate the identification and contracting of external consultants for HI in the field of
accessibility (infrastructure and digital);
 To feed and enrich HI's technical response capacity in the field of accessibility

2. The missions covered by this call for applications

The selected consultants should be able to carry out technical expertise missions in support
of HI's technical permanent teams at headquarters or in the programs, in the field of
ACCESSIBILITY, including digital accessibility, for people with disabilities.

 within the framework of the implementation of one or several activities of a
development project for which HI is the operator;

 Or in the framework of a technical assistance contract (consultancy) "Inclusion and
Disability", aiming at supporting a project team, a structure, a service or a policy to be
more inclusive to disabled people.
